title: Winter Squash
description: “This is a dish you’d happily eat the other 364 day of the year. A vinegar-and-chile glaze adds heat to sweet squash, spicing up the traditional Thanksgiving flavor profile.
ingredients: 2-pound kabocha squash, peeled, seeds removed, cut into 1-inch wedges
delicata or dumpling squashes, seeds removed, cut into 1-inch wedges
2 Fresno chiles, thinly sliced in rings
1 2-pound kabocha squash, peeled, seeds removed, cut into 1-inch wedges
2 delicata or dumpling squashes, seeds removed, cut into 1-inch wedges
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Place kabocha and delicata squash on separate large rimmed baking sheets. Drizzle with oil; season with salt and pepper. Roast, tossing occasionally, until squashes are golden brown and tender, 30–35 minutes for kabocha and 20–25 minutes for delicata.

Meanwhile, bring chiles, vinegar, honey, raisins, red pepper flakes, and a pinch of salt to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Reduce heat and simmer until syrupy, 8–10 minutes. (Maybe broil as moment to carmelize.)
Brush half of warm agrodolce over warm squash. Transfer to a platter.
Just before serving, reheat remaining agrodolce, adding a splash of water if needed to loosen. Spoon over squash
Do Ahead: Dish can be made 3 hours ahead. Store tightly wrapped at room temperature. Winter Squash Agrodolce
A vinegar-and-chile glaze adds heat to sweet squash, spicing up the traditional Thanksgiving flavor profile.
